meta.description: 《天星十三宫》是一款以星宫、世界界壁与天外来客为主题的内容扩展模组。当前版本将一条新的星宫主线嵌入原版流程，从克苏鲁之眼后延伸至月亮领主之后，包含 7 场 Boss 战、15 种敌怪、38 把覆盖四职业的武器、31 件护甲与 30 件饰品。Boss 战强调位置管理、预警阅读、弹幕编排与独立阶段机制；世界内容包含世纪之花后的残星矿物、随进度进入原版生态的新敌怪，以及击破界壁后开启的高空界外遭遇。当前为 0.1 持续开发版本，Boss Checklist 为可选兼容。

description.zh: 远早于一切文字记载便已包裹世界的古老界膜，令泰拉瑞亚与宇宙深空中的诸多存在彼此隔绝。月亮领主陨落后，星宫的重重征兆令冒险者意识到，继续被动等待只会迎来下一次入侵。于是破界星仪被转向天外——这条通往那些古老、近乎神明的存在的道路，将由世界自身以武力撕开。
description.en: An ancient membrane that enclosed the world long before recorded history, keeping Terraria apart from the beings of deep space. After the Moon Lord's fall and repeated signs of the Astral Courts' designs, the adventurer refuses to await another invasion. The Horizonbreaker Astrolabe turns outward, and the first deliberate passage toward those ancient, godlike beings is torn open by force.

spawnInfo.en: Deliberately breach the boundary with a [i:ThirteenAstralCourts/HorizonbreakerAstrolabe] on the surface or in space after defeating the Moon Lord

description.en: The First Astral Court's apostle remains upon Terraria, observing the ceaseless procession of the celestial courts and carrying their faith beneath the night sky.

description.zh: 天星第三宫·岁华的宫主。流曜端坐于不断展开的纪元长卷之上，将众生走过的位置、尚未抵达的时刻与门后可能应验的天象一并写入此页。
description.en: Lord of Suihua, the Third Astral Court. Seated upon an ever-unfolding chronicle of ages, Liuyao writes every traveled position, every approaching instant, and every phenomenon that may answer beyond the gates onto the present page.

spawnInfo.zh: 击败昭回后，在地表或太空的开阔天空下使用[i:ThirteenAstralCourts/SuihuaPageSigil]留下未决页签

description.zh: 天星十三宫投向凡世的第一层可见界面。昭回亲自垂临，观测、记录，并试图把一切异常重新写回诸天可以解释的未来。
description.en: The first visible interface of the Thirteen Astral Courts. Zhaohui descends in person to observe, record, and return every anomaly to a future the heavens can explain.

spawnInfo.zh: 击败界壁后，在开阔天空下使用[i:ThirteenAstralCourts/PetitioningJadeTablet]请昭回垂象
spawnInfo.en: After defeating the World Boundary, invoke Zhaohui with a [i:ThirteenAstralCourts/PetitioningJadeTablet] beneath open sky

description.zh: 星宫派出的前线侦察巡洋舰。它沿逆向观测的回波抵达泰拉瑞亚，将冒险者的好奇变成了可供航行的世界坐标，以及一份已经踏上归途的军事报告。
description.en: A forward survey cruiser dispatched by the Astral Courts. It followed the reverse-observation echo back to Terraria, transforming the adventurer's curiosity into a navigable coordinate and a military report already racing home.

spawnInfo.zh: 击败世纪之花后，在夜晚的地表或太空使用[i:ThirteenAstralCourts/ReverseAstralScope]召唤天星巡洋舰 HX-301

description.zh: 以星轨残光为食的低等界外生物。腐化与猩红像是世界界壁渗漏的伤口，它们的气息会把迷途的幼虫引向泰拉瑞亚。
description.en: A lowly creature from beyond the world that feeds upon the light left in stellar trajectories. The Corruption and Crimson resemble wounds in the boundary, and their scent draws lost larvae toward Terraria.

spawnInfo.zh: 在夜晚的腐化之地或猩红之地地表使用[i:ThirteenAstralCourts/StarfaringEgg]召唤星游幼虫
spawnInfo.en: At night on the surface of the Corruption or Crimson, use a [i:ThirteenAstralCourts/StarfaringEgg]

description.en: The ancient beacon failed to draw the Astral Courts' attention, awakening instead a solitary star wandering beyond the world's boundary. It is no member of the Courts, merely a creature displaced from another reality—and perhaps one day, the adventurer will be grateful that it alone answered.

description.zh: 巢囊以低沉共鸣维持同类的活动节律。每次脉冲都会短暂加速附近的普通界外生物，随后巢囊自己也会沿预告方向俯冲。
description.en: A low resonance from the living nest regulates the activity of nearby kin. Each pulse briefly accelerates normal extramural fauna before the nest follows with a telegraphed dive.

description.zh: 逸散灵魂在玄武岩般的齿缝间燃烧，始终无法冷却成寻常火焰。猎犬群会循着灰烬被扰动时扬起的火星追踪猎物。
description.en: Released souls kindle between its basalt teeth, never quite cooling into ordinary flame. Packs track prey by the sparks left behind in disturbed ash.

description.zh: 古老邪恶再度躁动后，暗影鳞片的碎屑沿它的脊背聚成黑棘。贴伏地面的尖刺能听见深谷传来的每一步震动。
description.en: Fragments of shadow scale gathered along its back after the ancient evil stirred anew. Its low black spines feel every footfall carried through the chasms.

description.zh: 它把冻结的灵魂压进脚垫，沿雪面滑出近乎笔直的霜轨。坚墙能令它折返，却也会让它短暂失去平衡。
description.en: Frozen souls packed into its paws carry it along an almost perfect frost-trail. A solid wall sends it back, but leaves it briefly unsteady.

description.zh: 高空气流不断把空岛晶屑钉进羽毛，直至鸟与风暴难以分辨。它只在云层刮擦岩石之处筑巢。
description.en: High winds drive sky-island crystal flakes into its feathers until bird and storm become difficult to tell apart. It nests only where clouds scrape stone.

description.zh: 地热与灵魂之火把沙粒熔成了额前通透的琉璃角。它能用这支角分开夯实沙层，却从不在玻璃上留下划痕。
description.en: Heat and soul-fire fused desert grains into the clear horn upon its brow. It parts packed sand without scratching the glass.

description.zh: 它们把月光收进翅上的眼纹，在短暂凝视后猛然扑向夜行者；轻薄的躯体也很容易被击退。
description.en: These moths gather moonlight in the eye-shaped patterns on their wings, stare for a moment, then rush at travelers. Their slight bodies are easily knocked away.

description.zh: 它滤食蘑菇洞中的发光孢子。受惊时，菌伞会一直鼓胀，直到透亮菌褶变成一盏醒目的警戒灯。
description.en: It feeds by filtering luminous spores from the mushroom caverns. When startled, its cap swells until the glowing gills form a bright warning lantern.

description.zh: 它伏在机关旁取暖时，神庙守护符会映上鳞背。蜥蜴人将不断变化的纹路视作石墙亲自写下的记录。
description.en: Temple wards reflect across its scales as it basks beside the mechanisms. The lizardfolk regard its changing markings as a record written by the stone itself.

description.zh: 钙化血管构成了它掘开活石的巨钳。它潜伏在猩红之地搏动的肉壁之后，直到新鲜血气扰动墙体。
description.en: Calcified vessels form the claws with which it burrows through living stone. It waits behind the Crimson's pulsing walls until fresh blood disturbs them.

description.zh: 世纪之花的凋零扰动了地表的星光。微小游星于夜色中徘徊，将积蓄的辉芒射向一切靠近者。
description.en: Plantera's fall disturbed the starlight above the surface. These tiny wanderers drift through the night, firing their gathered radiance at anything that approaches.

description.zh: 血肉之墙倒下后，沙海中的灵魂热流被它收进尾针。它会先在沙下留下清晰的蜃纹，再从那一点破沙而出。
description.en: After the Wall of Flesh fell, currents of released souls gathered in its stinger. A clear mirage-ripple always marks where it will break the sand.

description.zh: 破碎月核的尘埃沉入古老菌丝网，催生出一具会行走的子实体。它的菌冠经过之处，洞穴地面都会暂时黯淡。
description.en: Dust from the broken moon settled into an ancient fungal network and raised a wandering fruiting body. The cavern floor dims wherever its cap passes overhead.

description.zh: 地牢封存的回声与残月冷光混在一起。它空洞的咏唱会唤醒那些历代闯入者都未能令其沉寂的符文。
description.en: The dungeon's sealed echoes mingled with light from the ruined moon. Its hollow chant wakes the runes that generations of intruders failed to silence.

description.zh: 月核崩落时，它吞下了照进沙海的第一束余辉。成对镜羽会先在空中划出交叉蜃线，而它总在光线散去后俯冲。
description.en: It swallowed the first afterglow to reach the dunes when the lunar core collapsed. Its paired mirror-feathers draw crossing mirage-lines before it dives.

description.zh: 月质金属沉过世界地层，最终溶入最深处的熔岩。这只蝾螈把合金藏在皮肤之下，如同一层活着的炉衬。
description.en: Lunar metal sank through the world and dissolved in the deepest lava. This salamander carries the alloy beneath its skin like a living furnace lining.

description.zh: 月亮领主的寒光沉入冰层，最终从它的翼尖醒来。每一道霜痕都先标出冰刺将落下的位置。
description.en: The Moon Lord's cold light sank into the ice and awoke at the tips of its wings. Every rime-mark reveals where an icicle will fall.

description.zh: 月核残质渗入一枚腐化囊肿，令腐朽睁开了唯一的眼。细小病灶如同绕着黑暗世界运行的坏月，盘旋在它身旁。
description.en: Lunar residue seeped into a Corruption cyst and gave its decay a single wakeful eye. Smaller growths orbit it like diseased moons around a dark world.

description.zh: 一枚被遗忘的神庙封印吸收了月战最后的震颤。石肢从墙中展开，只为继续守护一条已无人记得的誓约。
description.en: A forgotten temple seal absorbed the final tremor of the lunar battle. Stone limbs unfolded from the wall, compelled to guard an oath no living priest remembers.

description.zh: 滞留在宽大翼膜里的月尘把高空气流鼓成银色船帆。从地面仰望，它像一片逆风而行的破碎夜幕。
description.en: Lunar dust trapped in its broad membrane turns the upper air into a silver sail. From below, it resembles a torn piece of night moving against the wind.

description.zh: 月光穿过被遗弃的猩红组织，教会碎肉重新缝合自身。它身上的每条苍白脉络，都来自一具不同的失败躯壳。
description.en: Moonlight threaded itself through discarded Crimson tissue and taught the flesh to join itself anew. Every pale vein upon it belongs to a different failed body.

description.zh: 月核碎屑越过浪尖沉入深海，唤醒了这条狭长的漂游者。它的鳍在本应照不到月光的水层留下冰蓝尾痕。
description.en: Shards of the fallen lunar core sank beyond the surf and woke this long-bodied drifter. Its fins leave a cold blue wake where no moonlight should reach.

description.zh: 珍珠石尘在甲壳上层叠成棱镜。即使身处黑暗，这只甲虫也会背着一弯游动的小型彩虹穿过神圣之地。
description.en: Pearlstone dust plates its shell in overlapping prisms. Even in darkness, the beetle carries a small wandering rainbow across the Hallow.

description.zh: 漂浮于裂隙边缘的灯母会把猎物的运动写进发光核心，随后沿预测位置贯出一道宽阔束流。逼近它能迫使其取消蓄能并后撤。
description.en: Drifting beside dimensional wounds, the matron writes a target's motion into its luminous core before projecting a broad beam through the predicted position. Closing in forces it to abandon the channel and retreat.

description.en: Old dungeon sigils have taken root in a fallen guard's bones. It still patrols a route whose doors, prisoners, and masters vanished long ago.

description.zh: 界壁被击穿后，成群的游鳐循着裂口渗入近地深空。它们不会近身撕咬，而是在远处展开鳍翼，将三枚会短暂校正航向的界晶射向猎物。
description.en: When the World Boundary was breached, schools of these rays followed the wound into near space. They keep their distance and loose three seam shards that briefly correct their path toward prey.

description.en: Lunar dust settled in the canopy's gills and raised this slow-drifting mother of spore-fields. Its gills bloom in sequence, leaving passable gaps between bright spore-rings.

description.en: When starlight reaches the earth, these beetles arrive before any stargazer to feed upon its fading glow. Their heavy shells make them difficult to push back.

description.en: Crystal splinters caught in its wing fibers weave moonlight into luminous lace. The pattern changes with every beat, as if the Hallow were dreaming through it.

description.zh: 沙海深处的密室曾在不见天日之地封存星光。这只圣甲虫破窟而出时，埋藏的辉芒正从甲壳的每一道关节向外燃烧。
description.en: Far beneath the dunes, a sealed chamber stored starlight for an age without sky. This scarab emerged with the buried radiance burning through every joint of its shell.

description.zh: 栖息在天穹薄气中的幼小星兽。它会折起宽鳍，将自身化作一枚沿星光坠落的利刃。
description.en: A young star beast that dwells in the thin air of the upper sky. It folds its broad fins and turns itself into a blade falling along the starlight.

description.en: The tide of souls taught it to read starry afterglow between the vines. Its opened scythes never lie about the line of its pounce.

description.en: Souls released into the coast fused wet sand around its borrowed shell. Each tide polishes the glass smoother while leaving the hermit within unchanged.

description.zh: 极少数巨鲸能够啃蚀界壁并沿伤口穿行。它会在巨幅冲锋与五道侵蚀波之间交替攻击；每轮攻势结束后，胸腔核心都会暴露片刻。
description.en: A rare leviathan capable of gnawing through a world boundary and swimming along the wound. It alternates between enormous charges and five erosion waves, exposing its chest core after every assault.
